name: @sos-2/tests-mission-to-repo
description: SOS 2.0 Mission-to-Repo Acceptance Suites (Work Order P13): the flagship end-to-end proof — a full §11 journey deterministically simulated (reference adapters/bodies/executors only), mission -> connected empty GitHub repository (reference adapter) -> typed authority grant -> the pipeline runs WITHOUT any user-online tick after kick-off (cloud ticks only, device-optional pinned) -> task + evidence timeline observed through the durable P2 observation events -> the repository contains the implemented system (reference executors; commits, push, pull request, deployment) -> exact source revisions + evaluation results + remaining uncertainty visible -> the completion record reproduces bit-exactly. Plus the pinned discipline suites: independence (the acting body's self-completion request is a typed EVALUATION_INDEPENDENCE denial and the journey never completes from it), ASK paths at every stage (formalization, planning, realization, completion), the bounded repair loop (failing evaluation -> repair/retry -> ASK), honest statuses (the default NOT_YET_CONNECTED evaluator registry yields UNKNOWN, never a fabricated completion), offline determinism (no ambient time/randomness/network/process in owned sources), zero new external dependencies (workspace:* + the existing toolchain only), fixed vitest seed 424242, only merged + P13-owned workspace imports.
